messages.subject: Editable Master-Detail
parts:
I have tried to shinyfy an editable master-detail scenario; you can run it via

 r -e "shiny::runGist('4721235')"

https://gist.github.com/dmenne/4721235
 
but I am not happy with it, because the code does nice.  Question:
  • Is it correct that whenever I need editable text fields that can be dynamically set from a database, I have to use the dynamic UI? While there is an input$myText, there is not such thing as output$myText.
If the above is correct, it means that almost everything in all but the simplest apps must use the dynamic UI. Hope I am missing something here; it's not very nice that the server creates the interface, this should be the ui.r's job.
  • There is a long delay for the interface to appear the first time, and it is distracting that the button comes up first, then being replaced by the full interface. What's wrong?
A minor point: How do I get rid of the info message when using the actionButton (Shinly URL starting with...)

Dieter

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Editable Master-Detail
parts:
Hi Dieter, thanks for the feedback!

That's correct, there is currently no way to modify input values directly. We hope to add that in a future version.

I'm not sure why there's a long delay for it to load the first time--there's no delay on my machine.

We emit the info message every time, I thought it was worth the warning when a package overrides a Shiny path since collisions there could be a frustrating problem to debug (or worse, a malicious package could inject its own JS into your app without you realizing it). I'm not sure anymore it was the right call though.
